title: Flat K-flat preservation and counit computation for integral Roos towers
statement: In the same prime, finite-extension and separated finite-type geometric setting, use the actual completed and constant ring sheaves and strict quotient towers of [def-sfb-integral-pullback-strict-roos-data]. For every flat-term K-flat complex P over R_Y, its ordinary R-pullback, its restriction to C_Y, and the C-pullback of that restriction are flat-term K-flat. The four canonical representative comparisons towerCounit(P), completedOrdinaryPullbackComplexCounit(P), completedReductionTowerComplexCounit(g_R^* P), and the constant reductionComplexCounit(g_C^* res(P)) are isomorphisms. The pulled tower assertion concerns its whole strict derived representative and does not assert that finite quotient terms are K-flat over R_Y.

proof.text: Constant completion equivalence makes R_Y flat over C_Y. Flat scalar restriction preserves K-flatness and flat terms. Ringed-topos K-flat pullback then gives both pulled resolving objects.
Apply the universal K-flat computation laws for reduction and ordinary pullback to these resolving objects. They give the ordinary pullback and the two reduction counit isomorphisms.

Completed-coefficient inverse image is exact by Cartesian coefficients, hence its termwise tower functor preserves quasi-isomorphisms. A strict diagram K-flat replacement of the source quotient tower computes derived pullback, and exactness identifies it with the ordinary pulled tower. Compose that counit with the source reduction counit to obtain towerCounit.

theorem integralRoosResolvingCounits
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] :
    ∀ (P : complexesR l E Y), GoodR l E Y P →
      (GoodR l E X ((cxPullR l E g).obj P) ∧
        GoodC l E Y ((cxRes l E Y).obj P) ∧
        GoodC l E X ((cxPullC l E g).obj ((cxRes l E Y).obj P))) ∧
      (IsIso (towerCounit l E g P) ∧
        IsIso (completedOrdinaryPullbackComplexCounit g (datum l E) P) ∧
        IsIso (completedReductionTowerComplexCounit X (datum l E)
          ((cxPullR l E g).obj P)) ∧
        IsIso (OrderedExchange.reductionComplexCounit (datum l E) X
          (((res l E Y ⋙ pullC l E g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
